arguments.value: 69-year-old African American woman with depression history and opioid use disorder on methadone maintenance presented with 1 week of new-onset paranoia, hypervigilance, insomnia, and collateral-reported confusion/agitation after stopping/missing methadone. Workup including labs, urine tox, and head imaging was unrevealing except for methadone positivity. She was treated with aripiprazole and later restarted on methadone, with resolution of psychotic and anxiety symptoms. Discharged stable with outpatient psychiatry and substance use follow-up; no recurrence at 3 months.
